hexagrams.name: The Receptive (坤 Kūn)
hexagrams.image: The earth's capacity: acceptance. The realized person accordingly sustains all things with generous character.

copy.hook: Tired of always having to lead?
copy.question: Who could you back?

current.title: A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains
current.why: The screen shows mostly calligraphy colophon with a sliver of blue-green mountains, so earth and receptivity do not come through at a glance.

hexagrams.name: Difficulty at the Beginning (屯 Zhūn)
hexagrams.image: Clouds and thunder: difficulty at the beginning. The realized person accordingly sorts the threads.

current.title: The Five Points
current.risk: The crowded street brawl of mostly Black figures includes period caricature that could read as racial mockery next to 'get organized'.
current.why: Chaos in a street fits difficulty loosely, but nothing says beginning or sorting the threads.

hexagrams.name: Youthful Folly (蒙 Méng)
hexagrams.image: A spring emerges beneath the mountain: inexperience. The realized person accordingly proceeds with thoroughness, developing character.

copy.hook: Asking again for a better answer?
copy.question: What’s your real question?

current.title: The Astronomer
current.why: A grown scholar studying a globe suggests learning, not youthful folly or asking once.

hexagrams.name: Conflict (訟 Sòng)
hexagrams.image: Heaven and water move in opposition: conflict. The realized person accordingly plans carefully at the start of any undertaking.

copy.hook: Fighting over something you’re right about?
meaning: Pushing to the end costs you.
copy.question: What fight could you leave now?

current.title: Night Attack on the Sanjō Palace
current.risk: Mild: samurai with bows and a burning palace, violence next to 'stop halfway'.
current.why: Warriors riding into an attack reads as conflict, though the screen crop shows mostly scroll text and a small procession.

hexagrams.name: Small Taming (小畜 Xiǎo Chù)
hexagrams.image: Wind moves across heaven: small taming. The realized person accordingly refines and cultivates character.

copy.question: What can you work on now?

current.title: The Card Players
current.why: Men concentrating over cards suggests patience, but not small taming or working on yourself.

hexagrams.name: Treading (履 Lǚ)
hexagrams.image: Heaven above, the lake below: treading. The realized person accordingly distinguishes high and low, and steadies the people's resolve.

copy.hook: Working for someone with a temper?
meaning: Treading says: mind how you step.
Act well and it won’t flare.
copy.question: Who do you tread carefully around?

current.title: Dante and Virgil Edge of Abyss
current.why: Two figures edging along a cliff over an abyss fits 'mind how you step' once you see it.

hexagrams.name: Peace (泰 Tài)
hexagrams.image: Heaven and earth interact: peace. The ruler accordingly completes heaven and earth's way, assists their proper order, and thereby serves the people.

meaning: Peace is contact, not a vacation.
copy.question: Who haven’t you reached lately?

current.title: Pilgrimage to Cythera
current.risk: Mild: cupids and a nude statue in a love-pilgrimage scene.
current.why: An aristocratic garden party reads as leisure, which the line 'not a vacation' argues against.

hexagrams.name: Fellowship (同人 Tóng Rén)
hexagrams.image: Heaven together with fire: fellowship. The realized person accordingly organizes by kind and distinguishes between things.

current.title: The Syndics
current.why: A closed board of men in black looks at the viewer, which reads as a club more than open fellowship.

hexagrams.name: Following (隨 Suí)
hexagrams.image: Thunder within the lake: following. The realized person accordingly, at nightfall, goes indoors for rest.

copy.hook: Still at your desk after dark?
meaning: Following says: go with the day.
copy.question: When will you stop today?

current.title: The Dance Class
current.why: Dancers following a ballet master fits 'following' by name only, and nothing shows day's end or rest.

hexagrams.name: Work on the Decayed (蠱 Gǔ)
hexagrams.image: Wind beneath the mountain: decay. The realized person accordingly stirs the people and nourishes character.

meaning: Decay says: it can be fixed.
copy.question: What’s overdue for repair?

current.title: The Third-Class Carriage
current.risk: Mild: poverty shown next to 'decay' could read as calling the poor decayed.
current.why: A dim carriage of poor passengers suggests hardship, but not repair.

hexagrams.name: Approach (臨 Lín)
hexagrams.image: The lake with earth above: approach. The realized person accordingly teaches with inexhaustible thought and protects the people without limit.

current.title: Bellini Procession in St Marks Square
current.why: A wide procession in a square does not suggest approach or planning for autumn.

hexagrams.name: Contemplation (觀 Guān)
hexagrams.image: Wind moves over the earth: contemplation. The ancient kings accordingly visited the regions, observed the people, and established teaching.

meaning: See by going, not by sitting.
copy.question: What could you go see?

current.title: View from Mount Holyoke (The Oxbow)
current.why: A vantage point over a wide valley fits 'go and look', though the storm and river pull attention.

hexagrams.name: Biting Through (噬嗑 Shì Kè)
hexagrams.image: Lightning and thunder: biting through. The ancient kings accordingly made penalties clear and established the law.

copy.question: What will you deal with now?

current.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
current.risk: Graphic beheading with blood, next to 'bite down' reads as endorsing violence.
current.why: Forceful action cutting through is visible at once, but the gore overwhelms the idea.

hexagrams.name: Grace (賁 Bì)
hexagrams.image: Fire at the foot of the mountain: grace. The realized person accordingly clarifies everyday affairs but does not dare decide disputes this way.

copy.hook: Polishing the slides instead of deciding?
copy.question: What needs more than polish?

current.title: The Kiss
current.risk: Mild: a romantic embrace next to 'small things only' can read as belittling love.
current.why: Gold ornament fits grace as decoration, but most viewers read the painting only as love.

hexagrams.name: Splitting Apart (剝 Bō)
hexagrams.image: The mountain rests upon the earth: splitting apart. Those above accordingly strengthen those below to secure their position.

meaning: Stay and help those below you.
copy.question: Who depends on you?

current.title: Nebuchadnezzar
current.risk: A naked, maddened king on all fours next to 'stay and help those below' is a confusing match.
current.why: Collapse and degradation read, but the helping message does not.

hexagrams.name: Great Accumulation (大畜 Dà Chù)
hexagrams.image: Heaven within the mountain: great accumulation. The realized person accordingly studies the words and deeds of the past to cultivate character.

copy.hook: Years of practice, nobody’s seen it?
copy.question: What have you been keeping in?

current.title: The Horse Fair
current.why: Men holding back powerful horses reads as taming great force, but not 'go public'.

hexagrams.name: The Abyss (坎 Kǎn)
hexagrams.image: Water flows upon water: the repeated abyss. The realized person accordingly maintains consistent character and practices teaching.

meaning: Like water: fill it, flow on.
copy.question: What's the next small step?

current.title: Snow Storm Steam Boat
current.why: A boat swallowed in swirling storm reads as danger in water, though 'keep moving' is only implied.

hexagrams.name: Influence (咸 Xián)
hexagrams.image: A lake atop the mountain: influence. The realized person accordingly receives others through emptiness.

meaning: The full can’t take anything in.
copy.question: What have you already decided?

current.title: The Kiss
current.risk: Mild: a passionate kiss next to 'influence' and 'make room'.
current.why: A kiss reads as attraction between two people, which is one meaning of influence, but not emptiness.

hexagrams.name: Duration (恆 Héng)
hexagrams.image: Thunder and wind: duration. The realized person accordingly stands firm without changing direction.

current.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire and the Viaduct of the Arc River Valley
current.why: A steady mountain view suggests permanence, but nothing says 'show up again'.

hexagrams.name: Retreat (遯 Dùn)
hexagrams.image: Beneath heaven there is a mountain: retreat. The realized person accordingly distances from the petty — not with hostility but with dignity.

copy.question: What are you ready to leave?

current.title: Over Eternal Peace
current.why: A small church on a far bluff above a vast river reads as withdrawal and distance, though few will know it.

hexagrams.name: Great Power (大壯 Dà Zhuàng)
hexagrams.image: Thunder above heaven: great power. The realized person accordingly does not tread where it does not accord with propriety.

meaning: Great Power says: check your aim.
Mostly, know what not to do.
copy.question: What won’t you do with it?

current.title: Lion Hunt
current.risk: Violent: men mauled and killed by lions.
current.why: Raw force is obvious, but the lesson of restraint is the opposite of the picture.

hexagrams.name: Progress (晉 Jìn)
hexagrams.image: Brightness emerges above the earth: progress. The realized person accordingly brightens their own character.

copy.question: What are you like up close?

current.title: The Fighting Temeraire
current.why: An old warship towed to the breakers at sunset reads as decline, not progress.

hexagrams.name: Darkening of the Light (明夷 Míng Yí)
hexagrams.image: Brightness enters the earth: darkening of the light. The realized person accordingly governs the multitude — using dimness to remain bright.

copy.hook: Your good ideas getting shut down?
copy.question: What light are you protecting?

current.title: The Ghost of a Flea
current.risk: A monstrous figure next to 'dark times' could read as grotesque.
current.why: A dark, starry scene fits darkness, but the creature does not suggest keeping your light inside.

hexagrams.name: Opposition (睽 Kuí)
hexagrams.image: Fire above, lake below: opposition. The realized person accordingly finds commonality while preserving difference.

current.title: David Goliath
current.risk: A boy holding a severed head next to 'share something, stay different' reads badly.
current.why: Opposition as combat shows, but the lesson of common ground is contradicted.

hexagrams.name: Deliverance (解 Xiè)
hexagrams.image: Thunder and rain arise: deliverance. The realized person accordingly pardons transgressions and forgives offenses.

current.title: The Hay Wain
current.why: A calm rural scene gives release in mood only, with nothing about forgiveness.

hexagrams.name: Decrease (損 Sǔn)
hexagrams.image: A lake at the foot of the mountain: decrease. The realized person accordingly curbs resentment and restrains desire.

meaning: Decrease says: give what you can.
Cut the anger, cut the wants.
copy.question: What can you let go of?

current.title: Winter Landscape
current.why: A sparse ink winter landscape suggests reduction, but the link is not visible to a scrolling viewer.

hexagrams.name: Increase (益 Yì)
hexagrams.image: Wind and thunder: increase. The realized person accordingly moves toward the good upon seeing it, and corrects faults upon having them.

current.title: A Sunday Afternoon
current.why: A still Sunday crowd in a park says leisure, not increase or moving toward good.

hexagrams.name: Breakthrough (夬 Guài)
hexagrams.image: The lake rises above heaven: breakthrough. The realized person accordingly distributes rewards downward, and resting in character avoids accumulation.

current.title: Liberty Leading People
current.risk: Bare breasts, corpses and revolution next to 'no force' can read as political and contradictory.
current.why: A figure breaking through at the front of a crowd says breakthrough at a glance.

hexagrams.name: Coming to Meet (姤 Gòu)
hexagrams.image: Beneath heaven there is wind: coming to meet. The ruler accordingly issues commands and proclamations to the four directions.

meaning: Coming to Meet says: be wary.
copy.question: What’s too good to be true?

current.title: Supper at Emmaus
current.risk: Christ as the charming stranger next to 'be wary' could offend religious viewers.
current.why: A sudden meeting at supper fits 'coming to meet' only for those who know the story.

hexagrams.name: Pushing Upward (升 Shēng)
hexagrams.image: Within the earth, wood grows: pushing upward. The realized person accordingly cultivates a yielding character, accumulating small things to reach the high and great.

current.title: Among the Sierra Nevada Mountains
current.why: Tall peaks and trees suggest rising, but not small steps piled up.

hexagrams.name: Oppression (困 Kùn)
hexagrams.image: The lake without water: oppression. The realized person accordingly stakes their life on following their purpose.

hexagrams.name: The Well (井 Jǐng)
hexagrams.image: Water above wood: the well. The realized person accordingly encourages the people in their work and urges mutual assistance.

copy.hook: Good things just out of reach?
meaning: The Well says: lengthen the rope.
copy.question: What’s cutting your rope short?

current.title: Aqueduct of Nero
current.why: A ruined aqueduct is water infrastructure, but reads as ruin rather than a well that never runs dry.

hexagrams.name: Revolution (革 Gé)
hexagrams.image: Fire within the lake: revolution. The realized person accordingly organizes the calendar and clarifies the seasons.

copy.hook: Making a big change nobody believes in?
meaning: Trust comes on the last day.
copy.question: What change are you making?

current.title: The Death of Marat
current.risk: A murdered man in a bath next to 'trust comes on the last day' is grim.
current.why: Viewers who know it tie it to revolution, but the image itself shows death.

hexagrams.name: The Caldron (鼎 Dǐng)
hexagrams.image: Fire above wood: the caldron. The realized person accordingly rectifies position and solidifies purpose.

copy.hook: Got the ingredients, not the result?
meaning: The Caldron says: set it right.
Get set up before you start.
copy.question: What’s out of place right now?

current.title: Soap Bubbles
current.why: A boy blowing a bubble has no visible link to a cauldron or setting up.

hexagrams.name: The Arousing (震 Zhèn)
hexagrams.image: Repeated thunder: the arousing. The realized person accordingly uses fear and trembling to set their life in order and examine themselves.

meaning: The Arousing says: use the fear.
Let it show what to fix.
copy.question: What did the scare show you?

current.title: The Ninth Wave
current.why: Survivors clinging on in a storm read as shock and fear, though it is sea, not thunder.

hexagrams.name: Keeping Still (艮 Gèn)
hexagrams.image: Connected mountains: keeping still. The realized person accordingly thinks of nothing beyond their present situation.

meaning: Stay with where you are now.
copy.question: What can wait?

hexagrams.name: The Marrying Maiden (歸妹 Guī Mèi)
hexagrams.image: Thunder above the lake: the marrying maiden. The realized person accordingly understands the transitory through the permanence of the end.

meaning: Marrying Maiden says: see the end.
copy.question: What does the end look like?

current.title: Olympia
current.risk: A nude courtesan with a Black maid next to 'marrying maiden' is sexual and racially loaded.
current.why: The painting reads as a sex worker, which belittles the hexagram about a secondary bride.

hexagrams.name: Abundance (豐 Fēng)
hexagrams.image: Thunder and lightning both arrive: abundance. The realized person accordingly decides disputes and carries out punishments.

current.title: Rooster and Hen with Hydrangeas
current.why: Dense flowers and bright birds read as abundance, though 'be the sun at noon' is not shown.

hexagrams.name: The Wanderer (旅 Lǚ)
hexagrams.image: Fire on the mountain: the wanderer. The realized person accordingly is clear and careful in applying penalties, and does not prolong disputes.

copy.hook: Somewhere new, feeling out of place?
meaning: The Wanderer says: keep it brief.
You’re a guest. Act like one.
copy.question: Where are you a guest?

current.title: The Gulf Stream
current.risk: A lone Black sailor surrounded by sharks next to 'you're a guest, act like one' reads badly.
current.why: A man adrift is alone and in danger, not a guest passing through.

hexagrams.name: The Gentle (巽 Xùn)
hexagrams.image: Following winds: the gentle. The realized person accordingly reiterates commands and carries out undertakings.

meaning: The Gentle says: say it again.
copy.question: What’s worth repeating today?

current.title: Cloud Study, Hampstead, Tree at Right
current.why: Wind-driven clouds read as wind, but not as 'say it again'.

hexagrams.name: The Joyous (兌 Duì)
hexagrams.image: Joined lakes: the joyous. The realized person accordingly joins with friends for discussion and practice.

copy.hook: Good news, no one to tell?
copy.question: Who could you call today?

current.title: The Lacemaker
current.why: A woman absorbed alone in lacework is the opposite of shared joy.

hexagrams.name: Dispersion (渙 Huàn)
hexagrams.image: Wind moves over water: dispersion. The ancient kings accordingly made offerings to heaven and established temples.

meaning: Remind them where they come from.
copy.question: What do you all share?

current.title: Nocturne in Black and Gold
current.why: Sparks scattering in the dark suggest dispersal, but not reminding people where they come from.

hexagrams.name: Limitation (節 Jié)
hexagrams.image: Water above the lake: limitation. The realized person accordingly creates measures and standards, and examines the nature of character and conduct.

current.title: Newton
current.why: A man measuring with a compass suggests limits and standards, once you look.

hexagrams.name: Preponderance of the Small (小過 Xiǎo Guò)
hexagrams.image: Thunder on the mountain: preponderance of the small. The realized person accordingly exceeds in reverence in conduct, exceeds in grief in mourning, exceeds in frugality in spending.

meaning: The Small says: no big moves.
copy.question: What small thing can you do?

current.title: At the Moulin Rouge
current.why: A night club scene has no visible link to small, careful conduct.

hexagrams.name: After Completion (既濟 Jì Jì)
hexagrams.image: Water above fire: after completion. The realized person accordingly contemplates misfortune and prepares against it in advance.

current.title: The Apotheosis of Homer
current.why: A crowned figure among admirers reads as achievement, but not 'stay alert'.

hexagrams.name: Before Completion (未濟 Wèi Jì)
hexagrams.image: Fire above water: before completion. The realized person accordingly carefully distinguishes things and places them in their proper position.

meaning: Sort things out before you move.
copy.question: What goes where?

current.title: The Veteran in a New Field
current.why: A man mowing a field shows work under way, but not 'sort things out before you move'.
